item.message: Skill descriptions were shortened to fit the 2% skills context budget. Codex can still see every skill, but some descriptions are shorter. Disable unused skills or plugins to leave more room for the rest.

item.text: {"brief_complete":false,"completion_reason":"Three material workflow and information-hierarchy decisions remain unresolved across Work, Workflows, and Runs.","questions":[{"decision_key":"work_tab_layout","label":"Work layout","context":"Work must support conversations while keeping per-conversation memory understandable.","question":"How should the Work tab organize conversations?","choices":[{"number":1,"text":"Conversation list, active transcript, and collapsible context panel"},{"number":2,"text":"Full-screen transcript with conversations and context in drawers"},{"number":3,"text":"Dashboard cards that open separate conversation views"}],"allow_multiple":false,"recommended_choice":1,"priority":84},{"decision_key":"workflow_builder_interaction","label":"Workflow builder","context":"Workflows must expose schedules, batches, stages, and stage authority without crowding the first screen.","question":"How should operators build and edit workflows?","choices":[{"number":1,"text":"Linear stage lane with foldout configuration per stage"},{"number":2,"text":"Form-based wizard with one stage per step"},{"number":3,"text":"Freeform node canvas with connected stages"},{"number":4,"text":"Editable table with one row per stage"}],"allow_multiple":false,"recommended_choice":1,"priority":88},{"decision_key":"runs_information_hierarchy","label":"Runs hierarchy","context":"Runs must make immutable evidence, artifacts, validation, and approvals easy to inspect.","question":"What should be the primary Runs detail view?","choices":[{"number":1,"text":"Stage timeline with evidence and artifacts nested under each stage"},{"number":2,"text":"Tabbed detail for evidence, artifacts, validation, and approvals"},{"number":3,"text":"Flat event log with filters"},{"number":4,"text":"Artifact-first file browser with run metadata"}],"allow_multiple":false,"recommended_choice":1,"priority":86}]}
